notes:
Original summary in replication paper is not treated as independent original-paper evidence.
Source follow-up: Original-only blind validation. Source is the published six-page article, printed pp. 1169–1174, rather than a manuscript or supplement. Title and authors visually verified on PDF p. 1. Rendered PDF p. 3 was inspected: the statistic is partial eta-squared .08 and p < .05. Frozen canonical text renders equals signs as 5 and ηp² as Zp 2; quotations preserve those exact OCR glyphs. The analytic sample inferred from the explicitly stated recruitment and exclusion is 50; the printed F denominator df is 49, which is inconsistent with an ordinary two-group ANOVA on 50 participants. Retained the printed F unchanged and did not infer sample size from its df. The mood-adjusted p = .095 is a different test and is not combined with this effect size. Requested d is not printed for this test; extracted the printed partial eta-squared without conversion.
